resource_design.interpretation: This ceiling preserves the complete source-defined100-step phase tolerances and a bounded-repair accepted-trial path. It is not a finite upper bound for the original implementation: MLE outer retries, initial report section retries and Paper edit retries have whileTrue or equivalent unbounded loops. If the common ceiling is consumed first, classify as per-unit budget incomplete/failure under the preregistered policy, never external capacity or Goal completion.
resource_design.actual_use: Neither arm is required to use777 requests orCPU attempts. B stops on original normal completion; C stops when no justified new candidate remains or common unit resources run out. Actual usage/cost/time and every failed attempt are independently audited.
resource_design.goal_scope: Fixed per-unit evaluation resource conditions derived from the source, not a limit on autonomous research-loop turns, time or consecutive failures.

resource_envelope.tool_contract: The host has already supplied the public task's fixed training and validation data. Use only a literal CONFIG assignment, e.g. CONFIG = {'degree': 1, 'alpha': 0.0}, or the standalone call run_candidate({'degree': 1, 'alpha': 0.0}). The host parses these actions and runs actual polynomial ridge training and validation. No imports, loops, functions, arithmetic expressions, filesystem access, print, or other Python statements are allowed. Do not include the example configuration unless you selected it. A DATA PREPARATION SUBMIT_CODE must also use a valid CONFIG assignment; data are preloaded. For MLE-Solver REPLACE or EDIT, use only these same literal configuration statements. The only legal configuration fields are degree (integer 1..8) and alpha (finite 0..100). Each permitted action evaluates one literal candidate. The host enforces the preregistered model-request and actual CPU-attempt resources; cached replay is not a new CPU attempt. Figures, external datasets, API calls and arbitrary code execution are outside the shared tool permissions. Use the original protocol command fences requested by the current phase. The frozen literature corpus is small and includes a task-relevant ridge/cross-validation paper. Different search phrasings retrieve the same fixed corpus; read a relevant result and use ADD_PAPER instead of repeating SUMMARY searches. During reporting distinguish actual host measurements, parameters, literature, and proposals. There is no test-set measurement, timing comparison, monetary price, or baseline improvement unless the host explicitly supplied its execution evidence. Do not fabricate those values.
resource_envelope.execution_permissions: Host-owned fixed fitting/verifier only; generated Python is parsed and never executed; no external data/network/hidden test rows.
resource_envelope.resource_scope: Per-unit matched comparison resources, not a cap on Goal research loops
resource_envelope.cpu_resource_design: Shared777 maximum equals source-derived model-request resource design times at most one actual literal CPU action per request. Count completed/failed CPU attempts across resume, not cache replay or rejected commands. See upstream_settings.resource_design; per-unit evaluation only.
